envelope.cause: rulings on the corrected-shards planner's hypotheses, 2026-09-29

payload.gloss: the position an agent holds is what its host routes a model by. Each agent carries to the harness the role it holds, never a model; the host decides which model fills each role. Where the host has decided nothing, the agent runs on the harness's nearest built-in route for that kind of work (its ordinary default where it has none), or, on a harness that routes only by tier, on the tier suited to the position's work: work that holds, cuts or judges against the design (architect, planner, assayer) on the top tier; spec-bounded work (implementer, integrator) on the middle tier. Install makes the roles visible to the host as something it can set, and never changes a choice the host has made.
